summary: Dungeon / place-name window: binds the 'win_dungeon_place' child window and copies the placement transform into it (and into the further child windows that follow it).
evidence: Create 0x001CF8C0 calls Ui_Widget_FindPaneAndNotify(self, self+0x13C, 'win_dungeon_place', 0) to bind the child window, copies the transform at +0x130 into the child slot at +0x154 with 0x001235A4 and starts the child with 0x0029126C; the same four-instruction pattern repeats for the children at +0x188, +0x314 and +0x4A0 with their own transforms, so the batch size 344 covers only the first child.
